body:
[`Client#close`](https://github.com/Shopify/spoom/blob/c944a0e/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp.rb#L227) sends `shutdown` with `params: {}` ([lsp.rb#L228](https://github.com/Shopify/spoom/blob/c944a0e/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp.rb#L228)). The [LSP spec](https://microsoft.github.io/language-server-protocol/specifications/lsp/3.17/specification/#shutdown) defines its params as `void`, and Sorbet rejects the request:

> Unable to deserialize LSP request: Expected field `RequestMessage.params` to have value of type `null`, but had value `{}`.

So [`close`](https://github.com/Shopify/spoom/blob/c944a0e/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp.rb#L227) always raises [`Spoom::LSP::ResponseError`](https://github.com/Shopify/spoom/blob/c944a0e/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp/errors.rb#L36).

[`Request`](https://github.com/Shopify/spoom/blob/c944a0e/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp/base.rb#L34) now takes optional params ([base.rb#L42](https://github.com/dpep/spoom/blob/355a0cf/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp/base.rb#L42)). [`Message#as_json`](https://github.com/Shopify/spoom/blob/c944a0e/lib/spoom/sorbet/lsp/base.rb#L18) already drops nil fields, so `shutdown` goes out without a `params` field. [`rbi/spoom.rbi`](https://github.com/dpep/spoom/blob/355a0cf/rbi/spoom.rbi#L2292) is regenerated.

Tests: [`client_shutdown_test.rb`](https://github.com/dpep/spoom/blob/355a0cf/test/spoom/sorbet/lsp/client_shutdown_test.rb#L30) closes a client connected to a tiny Ruby server that rejects `shutdown` with params. It fails on `main`. The test server also accepts Spoom's current framing, so this doesn't depend on #1052.
